decisions.statement: Nothing under akasha lands at or past the file ceiling.
A line longer than the run budget is put in a run of its own.
The run line budget is recovered from the runs already there rather than chosen.
A page already at a slug keeps the id that page had.
The type a rendered page imports is reached by the id that type carries.
Where that type sits is asked of the index rather than spelled.
A rendered page imports the type file beside that page type rather than the page type.
A rendered page names its type and each run from the root rather than relatively.
The aggregate declares the whole set rather than re-exporting the runs.
The last page rendered is the aggregate.
A run no longer reached is taken away rather than left unimported.
A file already with the body rendered is left alone.
The aggregate carries no note of where the census was read from.
An empty census renders nothing rather than a clean answer.
Nothing under akasha is written here.
Each body staged is named to the caller as soon as that body is written.
The message and the landing script are named apart from the bodies.
The runs already there are asked of the index rather than read off the folder.

definition: a census of names divided into module pages that fit and the page composing them back
